breve: A class used to provide 'PhysicsServer3DExtension._soft_body_update_rendering_server' with a rendering handler for soft bodies.

metodos.desc: Called by the PhysicsServer3D to set the bounding box for the SoftBody3D.

metodos.assinatura: _set_normal(vertex_id: int, normal: Vector3) -> void virtual required
metodos.desc:
Called by the PhysicsServer3D to set the normal for the SoftBody3D vertex at the index specified by 'vertex_id'.
Note: The 'normal' parameter used to be of type const void* prior to Godot 4.2.

metodos.assinatura: _set_vertex(vertex_id: int, vertex: Vector3) -> void virtual required
metodos.desc:
Called by the PhysicsServer3D to set the position for the SoftBody3D vertex at the index specified by 'vertex_id'.
Note: The 'vertex' parameter used to be of type const void* prior to Godot 4.2.
